en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with an ornate oak‑leaf border around two separate photographs of bridges over rivers. The upper image shows a long bridge spanning a wide river, viewed from a distance, labeled in German. The lower image shows a wooden bridge with structural damage or collapse over another river, also labeled in German. At the bottom is a greeting line naming the city, written in German Fraktur/antiqua style.
